characters.name: Pip Thistledown
characters.personality: Bubbly scout who narrates everything she does out loud
characters.idle: hops in place, straightening her acorn cap
characters.victory: cartwheel while petals burst from her satchel
characters.silhouette: tall acorn cap with a feather tuft

characters.name: Bramble Quill
characters.personality: Grumpy hedgehog mechanic who secretly loves the cheering
characters.idle: polishes his spiky helmet with a rag
characters.victory: takes a deep bow and fans his quills like a peacock

characters.name: Marigold Hoofsworth
characters.personality: Gentle giant deer who bakes and hugs every rival after the race
characters.victory: lifts the trophy overhead on her antlers

characters.name: Fennel Vix
characters.personality: Sly fox courier who always claims she planned it
characters.idle: flicks her tail, checks a pocket watch
characters.victory: spins her tail like a fan and winks

characters.name: Hobb Mossback
characters.personality: Slow-talking tortoise farmer, completely unshakable
characters.idle: tucks head in and out of the shell
characters.victory: shell spins like a top with the trophy on it

characters.name: Juniper Wren
characters.personality: Songbird sprinter who hums the whole race
characters.idle: taps the steering wheel in rhythm
characters.victory: flaps up and lands on the kart nose, singing
characters.silhouette: tiny wings flared at the shoulders

characters.name: Clover Dash
characters.personality: Over-caffeinated bunny who speed-reads the map
characters.victory: triple back-flip with a fist pump

characters.name: Sage Willowmere
characters.personality: Calm owl tactician who whispers race advice to himself
characters.idle: swivels his head almost all the way round
characters.victory: glides a slow victory loop with wings out
characters.silhouette: big round facial disc and ear tufts

characters.name: Barnaby Bruin
characters.personality: Honey-loving bear who befriends every rival by lap two
characters.victory: bear-hugs the trophy and a nearby official
characters.silhouette: round ears and a broad belly

characters.name: Captain Dusk Marlowe
characters.personality: Weathered tug pilot who calls everyone kid
characters.idle: leans on the wheel and sips tea
characters.victory: tips his cap as an air-horn sounds

characters.name: Gus Gantry
characters.personality: Patient crane operator who plans three turns ahead
characters.victory: picks up his own kart with a cheer (hook animation)
characters.silhouette: broad yellow hard hat and hi-vis vest

characters.name: Pearl Quayside
characters.personality: Ferry-boat kid with a heart of gold and a fast hand
characters.victory: coin shower from her oversized coat
characters.silhouette: tiny frame in a huge coat

characters.name: Nanuk Snowdrift
characters.personality: Gentle polar guide who never loses his temper
characters.victory: makes a snow angel on the podium

characters.name: Flurry Skye
characters.personality: Showoff ice skater who treats every corner as a routine
characters.victory: lands a triple axel pose

characters.name: Grumbald the Yeti
characters.personality: Shy yeti who is scared of going fast and wins anyway
characters.idle: hides his face in both hands
characters.victory: roars then waves bashfully
characters.silhouette: shaggy fur mound with tiny eyes

characters.name: Zahra Sandglass
characters.personality: Caravan navigator who has never once been lost
characters.victory: spins up a swirl of sand

characters.name: Scarab Sol
characters.personality: Beetle-folk bulldozer who pushes everything forward
characters.idle: rolls a small ball with his feet
characters.victory: spins the golden ball on one horn
characters.silhouette: gleaming shell and a single horn

characters.name: Big Top Boris
characters.personality: Strongman with a gentle soul and a tiny moustache
characters.idle: lifts a dumbbell with a pinky
characters.victory: lifts the kart overhead

characters.name: Lulu Lollipop
characters.personality: Candy-floss artist who sticks to the racing line
characters.victory: candy confetti and a spin

characters.name: Coral Calloway
characters.personality: Marine biologist who narrates the wildlife of every track
characters.victory: holds up a glowing jelly

characters.name: Cogsworth Whirr
characters.personality: Prim clockwork butler who is always exactly on time
characters.victory: ticks and bows precisely

characters.name: Pyra Ashgrove
characters.personality: Fire-sprite who runs hot and fast and cools off with a laugh
characters.victory: bursts into harmless flame

characters.name: Nova Starling
characters.personality: Hotshot academy cadet who wants first place at any cost
characters.victory: salutes with a rocket flare
characters.silhouette: visor helmet with a star decal

characters.name: Zorp Blip
characters.personality: Tiny alien pilot who speaks only in bleeps
characters.victory: beam-up pose with sparkles
